text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 白色短袖短T恤，奶油白高腰褶裥阔腿长裤，棕色凉鞋。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Edit this unoccupied textile-product catalog image. Replace only the trousers with ivory-white tailored high-waisted wide-leg linen trousers: fixed waistband, button and zip closure, belt loops and front pleats. No elastic waistband and no drawstring. Keep the white short-sleeve tee and brown sandals unchanged. No belt or accessories. Pure white background, full garments, no people or body parts, no mannequin.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
